selection.historic: 50 preserved records with run IDs dated 2026-10-18/19; eligible flags from pairs.json retained
selection.new: 50 manifest/manual_context positions whose recorded started_at and run IDs are dated 2026-11-08
selection.warning: Both campaigns reuse study_id langgraph_manual_20261018 and logical protocol hash; select by date + full run_id, not study_id alone

common_23_positions.selection: New campaign positions having same scenario and pair number as historical eligible pairs; removes integrado/1 and reforzado/1 from new campaign. It does not make code or images identical across dates.

formulas.aggregation: Arithmetic mean of per-pair ratios. Current panel rounds each pair to 4 decimal places before describing; full precision independently recomputed here from report measurements. Not ratio of pooled totals.
formulas.time: report.metrics.elapsed_seconds as read by dashboard.collect_run; not execution_seconds alone
formulas.units: TRTO and IDE in percent; ETV is a dimensionless ratio. Differences of percent values are percentage points.

limits: Different auditor/controller hashes and image IDs establish different executable contexts; do not establish which change caused each KPI difference.
Same ground-truth hashes, model name and limits do not guarantee identical responses, workload timing, prompts, environment or runtime state.
No causal effect of upgrades can be isolated from these campaign means.
Post-review November 9 acceptance and 775 software tests are different measurements and not new paired API audits.
No historical attempts or exclusions were overwritten or imputed.
